name: DALL-E 2
description: DALL-E 2 (unCLIP) is a 3.5 billion parameter text-conditional image generation model developed by OpenAI. It uses a two-stage unCLIP architecture: a prior model converting text prompts to CLIP image embeddings, followed by a diffusion decoder and super-resolution cascade (64x64 -> 256x256 -> 1024x1024).
keyFeatures: Hierarchical two-stage unCLIP architecture using CLIP latents
Image variation generation from visual input
Conceptual interpolation between images in CLIP latent space
High-resolution 1024x1024 image synthesis via cascading diffusion models
curatorNotes: Deprecated with shutdown date set for May 12, 2026 per official OpenAI deprecations documentation.
